title and abstract.summary: The study quantified spatio-temporal changes in species richness and assemblage composition of Danish butterflies over more than 100 years and assessed whether different functional groups of butterflies showed different temporal trajectories.

introduction.summary: The study analyzed a historical dataset of over 400,000 Danish butterfly occurrences spanning over 100 years to detect long-term changes in species richness and assemblage composition at local and regional scales, and evaluated differences in these changes among functional groups based on eight functional traits.

discussion.summary: The study analyzed a large dataset of Danish butterfly occurrences spanning over 100 years to reveal trends in butterfly diversity and species richness across local and regional scales. The study discusses the population trends and conservation status of several butterfly species, specifically focusing on sedentary host plant specialists and their association with different habitat types.
